name: combat_v1
doc: The one definition of what the melee model sees and does, read by the Python simulation (ml/pvp_sim) and by the mod (net.battlehub.core.ml). Every observation is (raw value / scale), clipped to [-clip, clip]. Directions are in the bot's own frame: fwd along its horizontal look, left to its left, up. Angles in degrees, distances in blocks, speeds in blocks per tick. A golden file (combat_v1_golden.json) made from this spec checks that both sides compute the same numbers.

observation.name: opp_fwd
observation.doc: opponent's feet relative to mine, along my look

observation.name: opp_left
observation.doc: opponent's feet relative to mine, to my left

observation.name: opp_up
observation.doc: opponent's feet relative to mine, up

observation.name: opp_dist
observation.doc: horizontal distance to the opponent (also beyond 8)

observation.name: opp_vel_fwd
observation.doc: opponent's velocity along my look

observation.name: opp_vel_left
observation.doc: opponent's velocity to my left

observation.name: opp_vel_up
observation.doc: opponent's vertical velocity

observation.name: self_vel_fwd
observation.doc: my velocity along my look

observation.name: self_vel_left
observation.doc: my velocity to my left

observation.name: self_vel_up
observation.doc: my vertical velocity

observation.name: aim_yaw_sin
observation.doc: sin of the yaw from my look to the opponent's chest (positive: it is to my left)

observation.name: aim_yaw_cos
observation.doc: cos of that yaw (1: straight ahead)

observation.name: aim_pitch
observation.doc: pitch I need to look at the opponent's chest minus my pitch (positive: look down)

observation.name: opp_look_sin
observation.doc: sin of the yaw from the opponent's look to me

observation.name: opp_look_cos
observation.doc: cos of that yaw (1: the opponent looks straight at me)

observation.name: on_crosshair
observation.doc: 1 when my look ray hits the opponent's hitbox within reach, else 0

observation.name: self_ground
observation.doc: 1 on the ground

observation.name: self_sprint
observation.doc: 1 while sprinting

observation.name: self_charge
observation.doc: my attack charge, 0..1

observation.name: self_hurt
observation.doc: ticks I still cannot be hurt again in full (0..10)

observation.name: self_health
observation.doc: my health / my max health

observation.name: opp_visible
observation.doc: 1 when I see the opponent now (in my view and nothing in between)

observation.name: opp_ground
observation.doc: 1 when the opponent is on the ground (0 when not seen)

observation.name: opp_sprint
observation.doc: 1 when the opponent sprints (0 when not seen)

observation.name: opp_since_swing
observation.doc: ticks since I saw the opponent swing (20 or more, or not seen: 1)

observation.name: opp_hurt
observation.doc: ticks the opponent still cannot be hurt again in full (0..10, 0 when not seen)

observation.name: opp_health
observation.doc: opponent's health / max health (1 when not seen)

observation.doc: the same, back right

observation.name: wall_7

actions.name: attack
actions.doc: click once, at the start of the decision

actions.name: yaw
actions.doc: turn this many degrees (positive: to the left), spread over the decision's ticks

actions.name: pitch
actions.doc: look this many degrees down (positive) or up (negative)
